name: omnioffloader
description: Offload WordPress media to any cloud storage, serve via CDN, and backup files to Google Drive.
author: Huzaifa Al Mesbah

scripts.i18n:po: for po in languages/*.po; do msgmerge --update --backup=none "$po" languages/omnioffloader.pot; done
scripts.i18n: npm run i18n:pot && npm run i18n:po && npm run i18n:mo && npm run i18n:json
scripts.i18n:build: npm run i18n:pot && npm run i18n:mo && npm run i18n:json
